info.title: Satflow Marketplace API
info.description:
## Satflow Marketplace API

The Satflow Marketplace API is a RESTful API that allows you to interact with the Satflow Marketplace. The API allows you to:

- **Item and collection Details**: Get information about items and collections on Satflow.
- **Listing Items for Sale**: Create and manage listings for selling items on Satflow.
- **Bidding Items for Purchase**: Create and manage bids for buying items on Satflow.
- **Listing Data**: Retrieve current listing information.
- **Bid Data**: Retrieve current bid information.
- **Sales Data**: Retrieve historical sales information.

**A great open source example on how to use the Satflow endpoints can be found in [Satflow Market Maker](https://github.com/SwapLabsInc/satflow-mm)**

### Authentication:
This API requires API keys for authentication. You can obtain an API key by contacting support on [Discord](https://discord.gg/satflow).
